cat > /app/work/vbattery.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, importlib.util, copy
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import check as C
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("vt", "/app/work/valid_tests.py")
vt = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); sys.argv=["vt"]; spec.loader.exec_module(vt)
data=b""; expects=[]; reqs=[]
for name, expect, mutate, raw in vt.cases:
    if raw is None:
        r = copy.deepcopy(vt.BASE)
        if mutate: mutate(r)
        raw = json.dumps(r).encode()+b"\n"
    if not raw.endswith(b"\n"): raw += b"\n"
    data += raw; expects.append((name, expect))
    try: reqs.append(json.loads(raw))
    except Exception: reqs.append(None)
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'],input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=600)
lines=p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
bad=0; nopt=ninf=0
if len(lines)!=len(expects): print("COUNT MISMATCH", len(lines), len(expects)); bad+=1
for i,(name,expect) in enumerate(expects):
    if i>=len(lines): break
    try: resp=json.loads(lines[i])
    except Exception: print("UNPARSEABLE", name); bad+=1; continue
    if expect=="bad":
        if resp!={"status":"invalid"}: print("SHOULD BE INVALID:", name, lines[i][:120]); bad+=1
        continue
    if reqs[i] is None: continue
    try:
        L=C.build(reqs[i]); st,val=C.check_response(reqs[i],resp,L)
        nopt+= st=="optimal"; ninf+= st=="infeasible"
    except Exception as e:
        print("CERT FAIL", name, repr(e)); bad+=1
print("valid battery: bad %d (optimal %d, infeasible %d)"%(bad,nopt,ninf))
PYEOF
cat > /app/work/advrun.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import adv, check as C
cases=adv.fam()
data="".join(json.dumps(r)+"\n" for _,r in cases).encode()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'],input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=300)
lines=p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
bad=0
for i,(name,r) in enumerate(cases):
    resp=json.loads(lines[i])
    try:
        L=C.build(r); st,val=C.check_response(r,resp,L)
    except Exception as e:
        bad+=1; print("ADV FAIL %-32s %r"%(name,e))
print("adversarial: bad %d / %d"%(bad,len(cases)))
PYEOF
